notes.title: Version 1.2 - Save File Compatibility Issue
notes.notes:
Due to structural changes made in this update, save files from previous versions are no longer compatible. Unfortunately, this means you will need to start a new game.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. This has been a learning experience for us, and we appreciate your understanding.

If you have already completed the game and would like to skip ahead, feel free to join our [Discord server] and reach out to the developers. We can provide a config file that unlocks all tales and achievements you have unlocked.

notes.title: Version 1.2 – Fixes & Improvements
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539195/373a467453491ec85859b4f125481424554ccf60.png

🛠️ Changelogs


 Improved story content and dialogue in *Is It Truly Satan?* and *Shut Your Eyes*
 Applied technical refinements to *Metamorphosis* and *Butterfly’s Lament*
 Added **Streamer Mode** – in-game music is now safe from Content ID issues
 Language selection now appears only once on the first game launch
 Controller input mode will be selectable only on first launch (resets after a reload)
 Removed fallback title (previously used as a temporary workaround)
 Enhanced Thai text rendering for better spelling and contextual accuracy
 Fixed a flickering box in the top-right corner when switching maps
 Various minor bug fixes and overall performance improvements


Version 1.2 - Save File Compatibility Issue


Due to structural changes made in this update, save files from previous versions are no longer compatible. Unfortunately, this means you will need to start a new game.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. This has been a learning experience for us, and we appreciate your understanding.

However, if you have already completed the game and would like to skip ahead, feel free to join our [Discord server] and reach out to the developers. We can provide a config file that unlocks all tales and achievements you have unlocked. Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: Version 1.1 – Fixes & Improvements
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45539195/f1751a79cf9996ed0f84e9f365d75dc68dd25293.png

Changelogs

📁 Save System & General Functionality

 Fixed Steam Cloud Save to ensure all save files are properly backed up.


📝 Localization & Text

 Fixed Thai dialogue issues in Is It Truly Satan?
 Fixed a Thai typo in Butterfly's Lament
 Fixed Thai line-breaking errors in Slime Swamp


🎵 Sound & Cutscenes

 Fixed the issue where music wouldn’t resume after certain cutscene in Shut Your Eyes


🏚️ Map & Environment

 Fixed tile collision issues in the old school building (left, right, center) to prevent walking through walls
 Made the first-floor exit of the school building more visible in Shut Your Eyes
 Moved the “Teacher” character to the sidewalk in Shut Your Eyes
 Reduced slime bounce height by 1 tile in Slime Swamp to make it more fun for players to jump on.


🧍‍♀️ Dialogue & Cutscene

 Fixed the ending scene in Slime Swamp to show the correct sprite.


⚙️ System Improvements

 Prevented the player from interacting with events while menus or special UI windows are open
 Fixed the bug that caused the “In Abyss of Tales” achievement not to unlock correctly
